shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | rg -n 'spec|anchor' && ls src/orchestration/tools && ls scripts/spec-links"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts')
s = p.read_text().replace(\"const ajvMajorVersion = Number(ajvPackage.version.split('.')[0]);\", \"const ajvVersion = ajvPackage.version;\\nconst ajvMajorVersion = Number(ajvVersion.split('.')[0]);\")
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('.lore/dod.md')
s = p.read_text().replace('- [ ] Add unit tests in', '- [x] Repair the latest CI validator version lookup lint finding.\\n- [ ] Add unit tests in')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff && git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m 'Fix validator version lookup lint' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
